label: The Musician
tagline: An engine that hears the gap between the click and the take.
cluster_explainer: The Musician uses the engine as a take listener — a reactive surface that holds the last gesture instead of snapping back to idle, the way a tape machine does between takes.
demo_highlights: Cube reads as rhythm block — the same shape a drummer would call a quarter note, returned across the loop
Grid preset lays the count bare: every line is a beat the musician can point at and decide whether to keep or quantize
Bass-dominant reactor tracks the kick and sub where the groove lives, not the vocal where the song might want to be
Hold envelope preserves feel across a take: when the musician stops playing, the engine doesn't snap back to idle — it holds the last gesture, the way a tape machine does
Deep violet refuses to look like a stage show — the demo is a session, not a performance
